name: 悠悠 · 小鲸鱼
prompt: A recognizable baby whale stuffed toy, plump horizontal oval body, rounded forehead, tiny lateral flippers and a short broad two-lobed tail pointing upward. Dusty periwinkle blue back, warm ivory lower belly. Two little black bead eyes and a small stitched smile. Keep natural whale anatomy, no legs, no arms, no horns. Soft dense fine velour fabric, uniform 2mm short pile lying in one direction, silky microfibers, subtle cloth seams, gently padded contours, a clean continuous smooth silhouette. Surface looks like brushed velvet NOT sculpted clumps; fine fur is in texture and shading, no bumpy wool geometry. Full body in a relaxed resting pose, finished all sides. A generic animal plush character with its own palette and proportions, no brand logo, text, accessory, ground or pedestal.
